name: IVR
tagline: International Association Representing the Interests of European Inland Navigation
hero_kpi_rationale: Le congrès annuel de l'IVR 2024 à Francfort a rassemblé 225 participants de 11 pays, démontrant l'engagement continu du secteur de la navigation intérieure européenne et la capacité de l'organisation à fédérer les acteurs clés du secteur malgré un contexte géopolitique complexe.

kpis.description: IVR 2024 annual congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17) attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries, representing the inland navigation sector's leadership and stakeholder engagement.

kpis.explanation: Representation across European inland navigation industry including shipping operators, insurers, and survey institutions.
kpis.description: IVR represents interests across inland shipping, insurance, ship's survey, and related sectors through multi-level governance: General Assembly, Board of Management, Executive Committee, Committees, and Secretariat. Maintains observer status in CESNI and collaborates with ZKR and European Commission.

company_description: Altri, SGPS, S.A. produces and sells cellulosic fibers in Portugal and internationally. The company produces pulp products for various applications, including printing and writing papers and for the textile industry. It is also involved in the timber and biomass commercialization; forest management; and real estate businesses, as well as production of plants in nurseries and provision of services related with forests and landscapes; logistics services; research and development activities; and production and commercialization of cellulosic filament. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Porto, Portugal.
